pages.text: Place the $(item)Pump$() by clicking the fluid source (a tank or a lake): it sucks from the back and pushes to the front. It drains up to 256 source blocks of a lake. 200 FE per bucket; a redstone signal stops it.
$(item)Fluid Pipes$() hold 1000 mB each, level out among themselves and push fluid into every connected tank except the one it came from (250 mB/t per side).
